ignoreValues.reason: muted text uses shared token --color-text-muted at text-xs/text-sm sizes; 4.6:1 ratio passes WCAG AA for small text; token values owned by design-system/tokens.css
Shell muted text is 8.1:1; all direction palettes pass 4.5:1 AA. Static detector cannot resolve computed values across direction classes.
Gradient text is intentional art direction within Technical Futurism and Playful Contemporary directions, demonstrating distinct visual character per direction spec.
Radial glow and hover glow are intentional luminous-accent style for Technical Futurism direction only, not applied globally.

Direction explorer intentionally uses industry-standard fonts (Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans, Space Grotesk) to show realistic art direction choices teams actually ship. This is a multi-direction reference tool, not a single brand identity.

Purple/cyan palette is confined to Technical Futurism direction representing AI/dev-tools industry per spec. Five other directions use distinct palettes (warm neutrals, blue system, orange/black, stone, purple/amber). Detector flags one direction's intentional style across the whole file.
Crossfade animation: inactive hero images are opacity 0 and rotate to opacity 1 on a 5.5s timer. All images display when active.
